No, the pedestrian will almost certainly not prevail. Fraud-based misrepresentation requires justifiable reliance and resulting damages, and he rejected the $1,000 offer and hired counsel, so he relied on nothing and lost nothing from the statement. Also, a misstatement of law is generally not actionable as misrepresentation, and unfair-claims-practice statutes usually give no private right of action.

CONFIDENCE: 85
